note: The Log Book, for staff (17 October 2026). Every name and number on screen is made up.

scenes.headline: The Log Book, for staff
scenes.sub: Receive, sign, send: the same day
scenes.line: This is the Log Book, as Client Support and the branch see it. Receive the papers, sign for them, and send them the same day.

scenes.headline: What is waiting
scenes.line: The Queue opens on what is waiting. Papers logged, and not yet handed in. Papers received, and not yet sent, grouped by department.

scenes.headline: Tick, and sign
scenes.line: When an agent hands papers in, tick them, and sign with your finger. If a department is wrong, change it. The Log Book learns from the change.

scenes.headline: One press, ready to print
scenes.line: Build the transmittal. One department, one press. It is numbered, with the date collected and the date sent on every line, ready to print.

scenes.headline: Late needs a reason
scenes.line: Same day is the rule. A line received yesterday, or after four, needs a reason before it goes. The reason prints beside the two dates.

scenes.headline: Did they get it?
scenes.line: Three working days later, the department gets one e-mail with a Yes and a No. A Yes is recorded. A No goes to sales support, and a Salesforce task opens for whoever collected.

scenes.headline: How the branch is doing
scenes.line: Insights shows how the branch is doing. The share sent the same day. Each department's answers. And a quality score for every agent.

scenes.headline: The day, in one e-mail
scenes.line: At five o'clock, the branch manager gets the day in one e-mail. What is late, what a department said it never got, and what was never handed in.
Receive it. Sign it. Send it today.
